subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued donors, We are delighted to invite you to our Annual Charity Gala on Saturday, November 20th at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an elegant evening of dinner, entertainment, and fundraising for a noble cause. Your support has made a significant impact on our community, and we would be honored to have you with us. Please RSVP by November 10th. We look forward to celebrating together. Warm regards, Charity Foundation
